info.name: ShopVerse - Complete API
info.description: Complete ShopVerse API collection derived from the Spring controllers and security configuration. Import an accompanying environment, run Authentication first, then use Customer or Admin folders. Public registration targets user-service directly because the current gateway route does not include /api/v1/public/**. Destructive and recovery requests are included but are never run automatically.
